CustomField.description: TRUE unless linked Contract's TCV/MRR (total + per LOB) genuinely differ from this Quote's Existing TCV/MRR baseline; TRUE (no problem) when no Contract is linked. Drives the Renew/Amend/Cancel "not in sync" banner (ASCEND-000003) - shows only when FALSE. TO CONSIDER: exact equality, not rounded - a trivial float diff (~$0.002) can read FALSE; round both sides if noisy in practice, deferred/not applied. NOTE: Record.ContractId and Record.Contract.Id both reject the NE operator in a flexipage visibility rule (confirmed on this org) - hence blank-Contract is folded in here via OR(ISBLANK(ContractId), ...) rather than a second rule criterion.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISBLANK( ContractId ), AND( NULLVALUE( Existing_TCV__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_TCV__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR_Cyber__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR_Cyber__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR_Desk__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR_Desk__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR_Infra__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR_Infra__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR_Private_Cloud__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR_Private_Cloud__c, 0 ), NULLVALUE( Existing_MRR_VOIP__c, 0 ) = NULLVALUE( Contract.Current_MRR_VOIP__c, 0 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Financial Metrics In Sync
